messages:
maya (partnerships): Hey team — CloudMatrix is pushing our listing through their marketplace compliance gate. They want SOC2 evidence, a pen-test summary, and an attestation that artifacts are redacted. Deadline they quoted: next Wednesday. Can security confirm what we can hand over and who owns upload/TTL? cc @sara @raj

olivia (security): Short answer: we can share a SOC2 Type II summary + a control mapping doc without sensitive customer data. Full SOC2 report requires legal+DPA signoff. For the pen-test, we can provide a redacted report and a vuln tracker export (CSV) with masked IPs/hostnames. Need decision on presigned URL TTL and redaction owner.

maya (partnerships): Good — CloudMatrix also asked for a named contact to ingest artifacts into their secure portal and a single point of contact for follow-ups.

Tom (partnerships): Does marketplace expect us to upload to their portal directly or provide presigned s3 links? Their questionnaire implies presigned uploads are fine but they want 24h+ expiry and an audit log.

olivia (security): We prefer presigned links with 24h expiry and server-side KMS encryption. Audit logs: we can export S3 access logs + CloudTrail events for the presign actions. Example presign we plan to use:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-artifacts/cloudmatrix/pen-test-redacted.pdf --expires-in 86400
```

olivia (security): Action items for security: 1) produce redacted pen-test PDF (mask IPs/hosts), 2) generate SOC2 summary + control mapping, 3) export vuln tracker CSV with hashes instead of hostnames. I can own 1 & 3. Need Legal for full SOC2 if they insist.

raj (hw-partner): For hardware partner attestations, do you need firmware SBOMs or just a statement? CloudMatrix asked about HSM usage for keys in our private deployment.

maya (partnerships): CloudMatrix only requested an attestation that keys are KMS-backed and not available to third parties. A short attestation letter should suffice for initial listing. We can attach more detailed SBOMs later if they request.

security-bot: Incident note: no open critical vulns in tracker as of last scan (2026-03-10). :white_check_mark:

Tom (partnerships): I'll update the marketplace intake form with fields: artifact_owner, presign_ttl_seconds, audit_log_link. Assigning owners: maya -> partner comms, olivia -> redaction + artifacts, tom -> intake/update listing, legal -> SOC2 gate.

sara (cloudmatrix): Thanks — CloudMatrix compliance team prefers 24h presigned links and a single SFTP alternative if presigns are not possible. They need a timeline by EOD Monday to keep the listing slot. Also, their portal will need an attestation PDF and a metadata.json with the following keys: `artifact_type`, `issued_by`, `redaction_level`.

maya (partnerships): We can hit EOD Monday. Plan: olivia delivers redacted pen-test + vuln CSV by Monday 12pm PT, maya sends attestation + metadata.json by 3pm PT, tom presigns and hands off S3 audit link by 4:30pm PT. Legal to confirm SOC2 full-report policy by close of day.

olivia (security): Confirming: I'll post the redacted PDF to the presign path `s3://redwood-artifacts/cloudmatrix/` and leave TTL=86400. Will include a small README in the bucket with redaction notes and contact email.

maya (partnerships): Perfect. @sara can you confirm whether CloudMatrix needs the vuln CSV column names or if hashed_host + vuln_id is fine?

sara (cloudmatrix): hashed_host + vuln_id + severity is fine. We'll map on our side. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :pray:

Tom (partnerships): I'll schedule a 15-min sync Tuesday morning to review the payload and ensure the marketplace portal accepts the metadata JSON schema.

maya (partnerships): Great — I'll create a follow-up thread with the upload links once presigns are ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
